programs.name: Master of Science in Applied Computing
programs.summary: A professional applied-computing master's with a dedicated Artificial Intelligence concentration.

facts.label: Application deadline
facts.note: The official program page states this deadline for Fall 2027 applications.

facts.label: Academic standing
facts.value: At least B+ (U of T 77–79%) in the final year of undergraduate study
facts.note: Concentration-specific prerequisites also apply; meeting minimums does not guarantee admission.

facts.label: AI concentration prerequisites
facts.value: Relevant exposure in computer science, statistics, or engineering, including calculus, linear algebra, probability/statistics, and programming
facts.note: The concentration must be selected in the application and is evaluated competitively and separately.

facts.label: References
facts.value: Three referees; ideally at least two academic references

facts.label: Tuition
facts.note: Not captured in this starter dataset; confirm on the official program fee page.
